section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sexual Opinion Survey (SOS), a 22-item measure of erotophilia-erotophobia used in the present study. Items are rated on a 7-point scale, and scores are computed as the mean of all items, with higher scores reflecting greater erotophilia. The text reports Cronbach's alpha values (.93 for women, .87 for men) indicating good internal consistency, but does not provide sample demographics, study location, or correlations with body appreciation or BMI.
